0022600034.text: The Pacers (3-8, 0-5 at home, losing two straight) host the Knicks (6-4, winners of four straight, 4th in the East) in the 13th game of Indiana's season. Indiana will be without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Ben Sheppard (knee), and Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), while Aaron Nesmith (knee soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pacers lost 1-3, including a 136-110 defeat in New York on March 17.
